## Privacy and security / 隐私与安全

- [ ] No real Claude export, title, message, screenshot, account identifier, credential, or personal absolute path is included.
- [ ] 不包含真实 Claude 导出、标题、消息、截图、账号标识、凭据或个人绝对路径。
- [ ] New fixtures and screenshots use clearly fictional synthetic data.
- [ ] 新测试数据和截图均使用明确虚构的合成数据。

## Worker and generated-file synchronization / Worker 与生成文件同步

- [ ] Worker source changes were rebuilt into `viewer.html`, or no Worker source changed.
- [ ] Worker 源码改动已重新构建进 `viewer.html`，或本 PR 未修改 Worker。
